purpose: Verificação documental da revisão antes de publicação
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, subprocess
root=Path('/Users/wkoch/Projetos/xrai')
plan=(root/'docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md').read_text()
state=(root/'docs/STATUS-IMPLEMENTACAO.md').read_text()
pat=r'M[01]-\d{2}(?:\.R\d+)?'
cards={}
for m in re.finditer(r'^### ('+pat+r') — ([^\n]+)\n(.*?)(?=^### M[01]-|^## |\Z)',plan,re.M|re.S):
    tid,title,body=m.groups()
    assert tid not in cards,tid
    dep=re.search(r'\*\*Depende de:\*\* (.*?)\. \*\*Frente:',body)
    assert dep,tid
    cards[tid]=re.findall(pat,dep.group(1))
    assert '**Entrega:**' in body and '**Aceite' in body,tid
expected={f'M0-{i:02d}' for i in range(1,13)}|{f'M1-{i:02d}' for i in range(1,24)}|{'M0-01.R1','M0-02.R1'}
assert set(cards)==expected,set(cards)^expected
active=set()
def ancestors(k):
    assert k in cards and k not in active,k
    active.add(k); result=set(cards[k])
    for d in cards[k]:result |= ancestors(d)
    active.remove(k)
    return result
for k in cards:ancestors(k)
assert ancestors('M1-21')|{'M1-21'}==expected
for k in cards:
    if k.startswith('M1-') and k not in {'M1-01','M1-22'}:assert 'M1-22' in ancestors(k),k
rows=re.findall(r'^\| ('+pat+r') \|[^\n]*?\| (concluída|não iniciada|em andamento|bloqueada) \|',state,re.M)
assert len(rows)==37 and {t for t,_ in rows}==expected,rows
assert {t for t,s in rows if s=='concluída'}=={'M0-01','M0-02'},rows
mds=[root/'README.md',root/'IMPLEMENTADOR.md',*sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md'))]
for p in mds:
    text=p.read_text()
    assert len(re.findall(r'^```',text,re.M))%2==0,('fences',p)
    for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',text):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        q=link.split('#')[0]
        assert not q or (p.parent/q).exists(),('broken link',p,link)
logs=root/'docs/relatorios/logs/revisao-L0'
checks=json.loads((logs/'checks.json').read_text())
assert len(checks['checks'])==8 and all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in checks['checks'])
ci=json.loads((logs/'ci.json').read_text())['workspace']
assert ci['headSha']=='10d9bf95490d405ea2d8014e95065295b32727c4'
assert ci['conclusion']=='success' and len(ci['jobs'])==3
assert all(j['conclusion']=='success' and all(s['conclusion']=='success' for s in j['steps']) for j in ci['jobs'])
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
assert all(p.endswith('.md') for p in changed),changed
untracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith('docs/relatorios/') and (p.endswith('.md') or p.endswith('.json')) for p in untracked),untracked
print(json.dumps({'tasks_main':35,'review_followups':2,'dependencies':sum(map(len,cards.values())),'acyclic':True,'state_matches_cards':True,'all_feed_final_gate':True,'M1B_requires_G1':True,'docs_checked':len(mds),'links_and_fences':'ok','local_checks_success':8,'CI_successful_jobs':3,'changed_tracked_files_are_markdown':True,'implementation_source_changes':0},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
